The '''natives of Yorgraxx''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. They had developed a level on civilization on their planet prior to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], before the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]] arrived on the planet. He used them as [[Slavery/Legends|slave labor]] to build his [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]], eventually causing the extinction of the species.
